submit_slurm_eval_job: submit a SLURM job for running Fast3R evaluation with specified nodes and config
run_eval_with_nodes: run the Fast3R evaluation script on multiple nodes using torchrun and SLURM
configure_slurm_parameters: configure SLURM job parameters including nodes, time, GPUs, and memory settings
setup_distributed_environment: setup distributed training environment with NCCL timeout and debugging flags
execute_torchrun_command: execute torchrun command with rdzv backend for multi-node evaluation
